text: LendingRobot can charge only a one percent management fee and a maximum 0.59 percent fund expense fee because its business model removes the investment adviser, overhead costs, and the legal fees attached to each individual investor agreement.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: Because LendingRobots' business model removes the investment adviser, overhead costs, and legal fees associated with each investor agreement, LendingRobot is able to charge a mere 1% management fee and a maximum 0.59% fund expense fee per year.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: describes LendingRobot's blockchain secured automated hedge fund
